info.name: Continu Reporting API
info.description:
All 14 endpoints of the Continu Reporting API, organized by domain. Each request is pre-populated with the available field flags (most set to `false`; set the ones you want to `true`). Filter objects are scaffolded with every available field; fill in the ones you need.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `base_url` variable (default: `https://usw2-oapi.continu.co/api/v1`).
2. Set the `api_token` variable to your Continu-issued token (just the token — the `Bearer` prefix is included in the request header template).
3. For dated endpoints, set `from` and `until` to Unix epoch seconds (UTC).

**Token notes:** Tokens have a 30-day TTL with no refresh endpoint. On expiry you'll get a 401 with body message `"invalid token TTL Expired, unauthorized request"` — request a new token from your Continu contact and retry.

**Rate limits:** 50 requests per minute and 5,000 requests per day, both per company across all tokens. Check `X-REQUESTS-PER-MINUTE` and `X-REQUESTS-PER-DAY` response headers for current usage (these are consumed counts, not remaining).

request.description:
**Content engagement signals**

Returns one record per content item with full metadata (id, title, type, published, created_at, tags, in_track_title, archived, views, likes, ratings, etc.). Works as both an engagement report and a published-content catalog — content records are returned regardless of whether anyone has engaged with them.

**Request body**: see the body tab. Set field flags to `true` to include them in the response. Provide values inside `user_filter` / etc. to narrow results.

**Path dates** (required): Unix epoch seconds in UTC.

request.description:
**Assignment summary**

Summary of assignments created, due, or completed in the date range. Includes per-record content_id, content_title, assigner info, and completion status.

**Request body**: see the body tab. Set field flags to `true` to include them in the response. Provide values inside `user_filter` / etc. to narrow results.

**Path dates** (required): Unix epoch seconds in UTC.

**Assignments pivoted by content**

Assignments pivoted by content (rows are content items, columns include assignment counts).

**Request body**: see the body tab. Set field flags to `true` to include them in the response. Provide values inside `user_filter` / etc. to narrow results.

**Path dates** (required): Unix epoch seconds in UTC.

**Assignments pivoted by user**

Assignments pivoted by user (rows are users, columns include their assignment statuses).

**Request body**: see the body tab. Set field flags to `true` to include them in the response. Provide values inside `user_filter` / etc. to narrow results.

**Path dates** (required): Unix epoch seconds in UTC.

**Simplified current-state assignment list**

Lightweight current-state assignment list (no date range).

**Request body**: see the body tab. Set field flags to `true` to include them in the response. Provide values inside `user_filter` / etc. to narrow results.

**Path dates** (not used): Unix epoch seconds in UTC.
